title: EXP-777 versus standard care in HER2-positive early breast cancer
official_title: A randomized, open-label, phase 3 study of EXP-777 compared with standard care in adults with HER2-positive early breast cancer (sample record)
brief_summary: Sample data. This made-up study compares EXP-777 with standard care after surgery in adults with HER2-positive early breast cancer. The primary outcome is invasive disease-free survival.
